summary: The Central Committee elected Lương Tam Quang to the Politburo, increasing its membership to fifteen.
date_basis: The dated Central Committee account states that the election occurred on 16 August 2024.
caveats: The retrospective English government roster gives 18 August, but the contemporary election notice establishes 16 August. Three simultaneous Secretariat elections did not confer Politburo membership.

office: Communist Party of Viet Nam Politburo
collective_body: Communist Party of Viet Nam Politburo
summary: The Central Committee elected Nguyễn Duy Ngọc to the Politburo, increasing its membership to sixteen.
date_basis: The Central Committee's first-day communiqué and the Party's official biography date the election to 23 January 2025.
caveats: The retrospective English government roster gives 25 January; the contemporary election communiqué establishes 23 January. Trần Lưu Quang joined only the Secretariat that day. Nguyễn Duy Ngọc's earlier Secretariat entry did not confer a Politburo seat.

office: Communist Party of Viet Nam Politburo

outgoing: Phạm Minh Chính; Nguyễn Hòa Bình; Lương Cường; Nguyễn Văn Nên; Nguyễn Xuân Thắng; Phan Đình Trạc
incoming: Trịnh Văn Quyết; Lê Hoài Trung; Lê Minh Trí; Trần Lưu Quang; Phạm Gia Túc; Trần Sỹ Thanh; Nguyễn Thanh Nghị; Đoàn Minh Huấn; Trần Đức Thắng
summary: The new Central Committee elected the nineteen-member Fourteenth Politburo. Nine members entered, six left and ten continued from the previous Politburo.
date_basis: The first meeting of the Fourteenth Central Committee elected the Politburo on 23 January 2026.
caveats: The complete outgoing roster published on 20 January includes Nguyễn Hòa Bình. No 2025 Politburo departure is assigned to him. Later changes in members' state or Party jobs are counted only if Politburo membership also changes.

outgoing: Council operating without Fathi al-Majbari after his July 2018 withdrawal
incoming: Council with Fathi al-Majbari again participating
summary: Fathi al-Majbari resumed work in the Presidential Council after withdrawing in July 2018.
date_basis: A 26 January report still describes an intended return. LANA's body-dated report establishes resumed substantive work by 18 March. Those reported positions bound the return; neither date is asserted to be the first completed day back.
caveats: This is an operative return after the already recorded July 2018 withdrawal, not a new legal appointment. The exact date and wider participation history remain unresolved. The 12 January political statement alone does not establish resumed executive work. No additional departure or return is inferred.

office: Conseil national pour la sauvegarde de la patrie
collective_body: Conseil national pour la sauvegarde de la patrie
outgoing: CNSP before Omar Boubacar Bala assumed defence zone 5 command
incoming: CNSP including Omar Boubacar Bala as defence zone 5 commander
summary: Omar Boubacar Bala joined the council when he took command of defence zone 5. Zone commanders hold council seats by virtue of their posts.
date_basis: Two state-media reports explicitly date the actual command transfer to 7 September 2025. No earlier appointment instrument was recovered.
caveats: The membership consequence follows from the legal rule. Bala’s immediately preceding battalion command did not qualify. Ali Hamidou/Hamadou Issa lost the Zone 5 seat, but no complete finding about his other possible qualifications is made. An earlier effective appointment, if recovered, could revise the date or require grouping with another same-day change.
